{{Conjecture|legends}}
A set of '''Imperial Military Shipyards''' was located at [[Seswenna/Legends|Seswenna]] during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]] and became the second headquarters for the construction of the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|First Death Star]] after [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]]<ref name="GG9">''[[Galaxy Guide 9: Fragments from the Rim]]''</ref> <ref name="DeathStarCoup">{{InsiderCite|Special Edition 2014|A Certain Point of View|A Certain Point of View: The Death Star Coup}}</ref> before eventually being succeeded by [[Patriim shipyards]]<ref name="TEA1">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> and then [[Despayre]].<ref name="TFUCG">''[[The Force Unleashed Campaign Guide]]''</ref><ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref>
